assertions.predicate: Release identity matches the merged watch consumer revision. Release smoke is only the first check; the supplemental notification count verifier in mcp-server/test/models/subject-watch-events/design.md is mandatory before live-proven.
assertions.expected_result: After release smoke, execute all five captures in the design note and tools/verify-subject-watch-proof.py verify --before /tmp/watch-before.json --after /tmp/watch-after.json --replay /tmp/watch-replay.json --removed /tmp/watch-removed.json --suppressed /tmp/watch-suppressed.json. Exit 0 reports watched=1, unwatched=0, replay=0, suppressed=0. The new notification has exactly /deals?deal=<watched UUID>. Original changes each add a receipt; replay adds none. Unwatch removes the subscription without a wake; a distinct subsequent change adds one receipt and zero notifications. Release identity alone never satisfies this product proof.
assertions.input_class: Read-only release and aggregate observations; coordinator performs registered watched/control changes, same-key replays, unwatch and a distinct subsequent watched-record change separately. The five-capture procedure is in the design note and verifier.
